conditions.name: steer
conditions.description: steering noise, attentive driver, sigma = 0.01 (1.6 deg at the wheel)

conditions.name: distracted
conditions.description: both together, distracted driver, sigma = 0.03 (4.7 deg at the wheel)

conditions.name: retracted_015
conditions.description: the ORIGINAL noise level (F96) — 23 deg at the wheel, not a driver; kept only so the correction is visible in the data

conditions.name: beyond
conditions.description: both, harder still — most laps leave the fit; direction only

beyond_is_not_quotable: The `beyond` condition is the only one that produces failures, and it reaches 12-17 deg of slip where the tire file has no fit. Its failure rates are reported for direction only and support no claim (rule 4).

inherited_d6.note: Episode 11 trains nothing; Episode 10's D6 applies and it fails exploration_is_not_growing. See FINDINGS F69.

comparability: Absolute lap times are NOT comparable with Seasons 1-2 (rule 6): different entry speed, and only the RL environment is being asked about disturbance rejection at all. Speed is measured unperturbed and fragility perturbed, deliberately.
